scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n contracts,api,web "npm run dev -w @seo-ai-analyzer/contracts" "npm run dev -w @seo-ai-analyzer/api" "npm run dev -w @seo-ai-analyzer/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @seo-ai-analyzer/contracts && npm run build -w @seo-ai-analyzer/api && npm run build -w @seo-ai-analyzer/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @seo-ai-analyzer/contracts && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build -w @seo-ai-analyzer/contracts && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
